issue.title: Question gate auto-resolution contract tests fail

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: The focused rerun reproduced four stable assertion failures: the standard profile returns question=ask, so question auto-resolution is disabled; the tests expect auto-application and a not_capable rule when capabilities are empty. Related nodes: tests/test_user_question_gates.py::test_auto_question_uses_first_options_without_publishing_pending_action; tests/autonomy_contract/test_landing_gaps_gates.py::test_empty_adapter_capabilities_ask; tests/autonomy_contract/test_gates_evaluate.py::test_non_manual_evaluations_log_one_row_including_questions.

issue.creation_reason: The full check and an unchanged-tree focused rerun both fail on the same question gate policy assertions, confirming a persistent CI failure rather than an intermittent result. This behavior is unrelated to the approved terminal-control changes.

evidence.note: Independent corroboration from Full CI 40109539212 at SHA 7b1b43755821fb4b6fe9ab8f51d09fcff0e46879: Python 3.12, 3.13, and 3.14 all repeat the question auto-resolution contract failures, including test_auto_applies_kinds and the same question-gate policy assertions. This confirms the tracked issue across three interpreter jobs.
